class Solution:
    def reorderList(self, head: Optional[ListNode]) -> None:
        if not head or not head.next:
            return

        # Find the middle
        slow, fast = head, head
        while fast.next and fast.next.next:
            slow = slow.next
            fast = fast.next.next

        # Reverse the second half
        prev = None
        current = slow.next
        slow.next = None
        while current:
            nxt = current.next
            current.next = prev
            prev = current
            current = nxt

        # Merge the two halves
        first, second = head, prev
        while second:
            tmp1 = first.next
            tmp2 = second.next
            first.next = second
            second.next = tmp1
            first = tmp1
            second = tmp2
